final_claim.narrative: A temporal reachability query constrained to max_wait = 600 found no time-respecting route from 1017 to 1593 within [42136,80535] (step_01). Allowing unlimited wait reveals a route (step_02) but its hop_waits include large gaps (e.g. 12524), exceeding the 600-unit threshold; therefore a genuine short-wait cascade is not present.
